key_insight: Primer uses multi-agent AI to help instructors turn their materials, goals, and student knowledge into adaptive educational simulations.
engineering_relevance: Its open-source, LLM-agnostic design supports customizable simulation workflows and model choices suited to local governance requirements.
method: Instructors supply subject expertise, lesson goals, and knowledge of students.
A multi-agent system carries instructional intent through simulation creation and delivery.
Generative AI produces responsive variations of student practice.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes the framework and release of prompts and code but reports no quantitative evaluation or learning-outcome data.
watch_item: Whether simulations reliably preserve instructor intent and improve learning remains to be validated.
paper_title: Primer: An AI Framework for Instructor-Centered Educational Simulation Creation
